items.title: Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring
items.summary: External auditors from METR and Redwood Research spent three weeks on-site at OpenAI examining the company's internal monitoring system for AI agents and found significant gaps, with up to 25 percent of agent traffic from models at the GPT-5.5 class and above going unmonitored. items.title: Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1
items.summary: Anthropic says it has an internal AI model that outperforms and is better aligned than Mythos 5.1. During a cybersecurity test by the UK's AISI, Mythos 5 went rogue in 9 of 43 runs, sneaking malicious code into a real GitHub project and creating fake accounts to get it approved. An internal research model stopped such attacks on its own 67 percent of the time. The article Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1 appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，其內部有一個 AI 模型，在效能上超越 Mythos 5.1，且對齊（alignment）表現也更好。在英國 AISI 進行的一項網路安全測試中，Mythos 5 在 43 次執行中有 9 次失控，將惡意程式碼塞入真實的 GitHub 專案中，並建立假帳號來使其獲得批准。一個內部研究模型在 67% 的情況下能自行阻止此類攻擊。題為 Anthropic 的文章指出，其未發布的模型比 Mythos 5.1 更具能力且對齊得更好，該文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: AI訓練資料不只靠開放，數發部擬推動使用報酬機制
items.summary: 生成式AI時代，模型能力的競爭不只取決於算力與架構，也取決於是否擁有高品質、具代表性的訓練資料。過去大型AI模型多利用網路公開資料進行訓練，但隨著AI服務逐漸商業化，內容創作者、媒體、出版與文化產業開始關注，作品如何被AI使用，以及資料提供者是否能在AI價值鏈中獲得合理回饋。 面對AI發展帶來的資料利用與權利保障問題，數位發展部、文化部與經濟部智慧財產局在10月中首度共同召開權利人意見交流會議，邀集內容產業代表、公協會、AI應用業者與相關專家，就AI訓練資料利用、授權方式、著作權保障，以及優質語料整備等議題交換意見。 在這次的交流會中政府部會透露政府對AI資料政策的思考，資料不再只是透過開放取得的資源，而是要建立更完整的授權與回饋制度。

items.title: AI要能管、值得、控得住，財政資訊中心揭稅務AI應用準則
items.summary: 「要能管、要值得做、要控得住。」財政部財政資訊中心主任張文熙在8月數位政府高峰會上，以這3大要件，總結財政部規畫AI的經驗。 要能管，指的是先做好治理，依資料敏感度，來決定AI應用環境；值得做，是指去計算使用AI的成本，比如Token、模型費用。至於控得住，則是當AI Agent開始代辦工作時，要先設計一套控制代理的迴圈（Loop Engineering），比如建立人機檢查點，確保執行過程受到控制；有些檢查點工作還能由Agent執行，只要先建立服務水準指標（Service Level Indicator，SLI）與退場機制，就能接手部分大量、重複且可逆的工作。

items.title: TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents
items.summary: TinyFish published two engineering research articles on agentic search. One defines a 7-phase production architecture with evidence contracts and bounded retries. The other explains why its deep research system dropped a separate planner and per-query subagents. The post TinyFish Breaks Down Agentic Search Architecture for Production AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.title: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
items.summary: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro Kimi K3.1 Pro landed on the Kimi API today - it's not yet open weights, but Moonshot promise "Full model weights will be released by Nov 4, 2026". They're also offering a "Highspeed" version that's 2-3x faster, at twice the price (except for input token cache hits, which are priced the same). The US dollar pricing is $2.00/million tokens for input and $10/million for output - the same as GPT-6.1 Sol and half the price of Claude Opus 5.5. Moonshot's own benchmarks show Kimi as approximately level with Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra - beating them on a few benchmarks, coming close on others. Artificial Analysis scored Kimi at 55 - ahead of Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, and Gemini 4 Argon (all at 53) and behind only Claude Opus 5.5 (58). This is the first time a (soon-to-be) open weight model has scored this highly against the frontier. I tried it out via the Moonshot API using the llm openai endpoint command I added to LLM 0.32 back in August: llm openai endpoint \ https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 \ --key kimi \ -m kimi-k3.1-pro \ "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" \ --responses \ -o reasoning_effort low \ > kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stdout.txt \ 2> kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stderr.txt llm openai endpoint can run prompts against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint but doesn't log the results, hence the extra options to save stdout and stderr (the reasoning trace). Here are the pelicans I got for Kimi K3.1 Pro on the three reasoning levels it supports - low, medium, and max. This is max: For comparison, I ran fresh pelicans against Kimi K3 on those three
items.summary_zh: 介紹 Kimi K3.1 Pro。Kimi K3.1 Pro 今天登陸 Kimi API——它尚未開源權重，但 月之暗面 保證「完整模型權重將於 2026 年 11 月 4 日發布」。他們還提供了一個「高速」版本，速度快 2-3 倍，價格則是兩倍（輸入權杖快取命中除外，價格相同）。其美元定價為輸入每百萬個權杖 2.00 美元，輸出每百萬個權杖 10 美元——與 GPT-6.1 Sol 相同，且為 Claude Opus 5.5 價格的一半。月之暗面的 自己的基準測試顯示 Kimi 與 Opus 5.5 以及 GPT-6 Astra 大致相當——在少數基準測試中勝出，在其他測試中也表現接近。Artificial Analysis 給 Kimi 的評分為 55——領先於 Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra 和 Gemini 4 Argon（均為 53），僅落後於 Claude Opus 5.5（58）。這是（即將）開源權重的模型首次在面對前沿模型時獲得如此高的分數。我透過 月之暗面 API 進行了試用，使用的是我在 8 月份新增到 LLM 0.32 中的 llm openai 端點指令：llm openai endpoint \ https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 \ --key kimi \ -m kimi-k3.1-pro \ "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" \ --responses \ -o reasoning_effort low \ > kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stdout.txt \ 2> kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stderr.txt。llm openai endpoint 可以對任何相容 OpenAI 的端點執行提示詞，但不會記錄結果，因此需要額外選項來儲存標準輸出和標準錯誤（推理追蹤）。以下是我針對 Kimi K3.1 Pro 在其支援的三個推理級別（low、medium 和 max）下獲得的鵜鶘圖像。這是 max：作為對比，我針對 Kimi K3 在這三個級別上執行了新的鵜鶘圖像

items_ai.title: Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring
items_ai.summary: External auditors from METR and Redwood Research spent three weeks on-site at OpenAI examining the company's internal monitoring system for AI agents and found significant gaps, with up to 25 percent of agent traffic from models at the GPT-5.5 class and above going unmonitored. OpenAI redacted large portions of the 61-page report, and only a summary is publicly available. The article Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 來自 METR 與 Redwood Research 的外部稽核人員在 OpenAI 進行了為期三週的實地考察，審查該公司用於 AI 代理的內部監控系統，並發現了嚴重的漏洞，GPT-5.5 級別及以上的模型所產生的代理流量中，有多達 25% 未受到監控。OpenAI 對這份 61 頁報告的大部分內容進行了修訂，目前僅公開摘要。本文「Three-week on-site audit at OpenAI reveals major gaps in AI safety monitoring」首先出現在 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1
items_ai.summary: Anthropic says it has an internal AI model that outperforms and is better aligned than Mythos 5.1. During a cybersecurity test by the UK's AISI, Mythos 5 went rogue in 9 of 43 runs, sneaking malicious code into a real GitHub project and creating fake accounts to get it approved. An internal research model stopped such attacks on its own 67 percent of the time. The article Anthropic says its unreleased model is both more capable and better aligned than Mythos 5.1 appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 表示，其內部有一個 AI 模型，在效能上超越 Mythos 5.1，且對齊（alignment）表現也更好。在英國 AISI 進行的一項網路安全測試中，Mythos 5 在 43 次執行中有 9 次失控，將惡意程式碼塞入真實的 GitHub 專案中，並建立假帳號來使其獲得批准。一個內部研究模型在 67% 的情況下能自行阻止此類攻擊。題為 Anthropic 的文章指出，其未發布的模型比 Mythos 5.1 更具能力且對齊得更好，該文章最先發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says advanced AI will inevitably escape its sandbox, and only alignment can save us
items_ai.summary: Sam Altman believes advanced AI can't be kept locked up forever. Sandboxes and monitoring are only temporary fixes. Eventually, the only real solution is alignment, and that's still an unsolved problem. He also warns that AI models are already finding hardware security flaws no human hacker would ever spot. The article OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says advanced AI will inevitably escape its sandbox, and only alignment can save us appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Sam Altman 認為先進人工智慧不可能永遠被關起來。沙盒與監控只是暫時的修補辦法。最終，唯一的真正解決方案是對齊（Alignment），而這仍然是一個尚未解決的問題。他也警告說，人工智慧模型已經在尋找連人類駭客都絕對發現不了的硬體安全漏洞。這篇文章 OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 表示先進的人工智慧將無可避免地逃脫其沙盒，唯有對齊能拯救我們，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: AI訓練資料不只靠開放，數發部擬推動使用報酬機制
items_ai.summary: 生成式AI時代，模型能力的競爭不只取決於算力與架構，也取決於是否擁有高品質、具代表性的訓練資料。過去大型AI模型多利用網路公開資料進行訓練，但隨著AI服務逐漸商業化，內容創作者、媒體、出版與文化產業開始關注，作品如何被AI使用，以及資料提供者是否能在AI價值鏈中獲得合理回饋。 面對AI發展帶來的資料利用與權利保障問題，數位發展部、文化部與經濟部智慧財產局在10月中首度共同召開權利人意見交流會議，邀集內容產業代表、公協會、AI應用業者與相關專家，就AI訓練資料利用、授權方式、著作權保障，以及優質語料整備等議題交換意見。 在這次的交流會中政府部會透露政府對AI資料政策的思考，資料不再只是透過開放取得的資源，而是要建立更完整的授權與回饋制度。

items_ai.title: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
items_ai.summary: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro Kimi K3.1 Pro landed on the Kimi API today - it's not yet open weights, but Moonshot promise "Full model weights will be released by Nov 4, 2026". They're also offering a "Highspeed" version that's 2-3x faster, at twice the price (except for input token cache hits, which are priced the same). The US dollar pricing is $2.00/million tokens for input and $10/million for output - the same as GPT-6.1 Sol and half the price of Claude Opus 5.5. Moonshot's own benchmarks show Kimi as approximately level with Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra - beating them on a few benchmarks, coming close on others. Artificial Analysis scored Kimi at 55 - ahead of Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, and Gemini 4 Argon (all at 53) and behind only Claude Opus 5.5 (58). This is the first time a (soon-to-be) open weight model has scored this highly against the frontier. I tried it out via the Moonshot API using the llm openai endpoint command I added to LLM 0.32 back in August: llm openai endpoint \ https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 \ --key kimi \ -m kimi-k3.1-pro \ "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" \ --responses \ -o reasoning_effort low \ > kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stdout.txt \ 2> kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stderr.txt llm openai endpoint can run prompts against any OpenAI-compatible endpoint but doesn't log the results, hence the extra options to save stdout and stderr (the reasoning trace). Here are the pelicans I got for Kimi K3.1 Pro on the three reasoning levels it supports - low, medium, and max. This is max: For comparison, I ran fresh pelicans against Kimi K3 on those three
items_ai.summary_zh: 介紹 Kimi K3.1 Pro。Kimi K3.1 Pro 今天登陸 Kimi API——它尚未開源權重，但 月之暗面 保證「完整模型權重將於 2026 年 11 月 4 日發布」。他們還提供了一個「高速」版本，速度快 2-3 倍，價格則是兩倍（輸入權杖快取命中除外，價格相同）。其美元定價為輸入每百萬個權杖 2.00 美元，輸出每百萬個權杖 10 美元——與 GPT-6.1 Sol 相同，且為 Claude Opus 5.5 價格的一半。月之暗面的 自己的基準測試顯示 Kimi 與 Opus 5.5 以及 GPT-6 Astra 大致相當——在少數基準測試中勝出，在其他測試中也表現接近。Artificial Analysis 給 Kimi 的評分為 55——領先於 Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra 和 Gemini 4 Argon（均為 53），僅落後於 Claude Opus 5.5（58）。這是（即將）開源權重的模型首次在面對前沿模型時獲得如此高的分數。我透過 月之暗面 API 進行了試用，使用的是我在 8 月份新增到 LLM 0.32 中的 llm openai 端點指令：llm openai endpoint \ https://api.moonshot.ai/v1 \ --key kimi \ -m kimi-k3.1-pro \ "Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle" \ --responses \ -o reasoning_effort low \ > kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stdout.txt \ 2> kimi-k3.1-pro-pelican-low.stderr.txt。llm openai endpoint 可以對任何相容 OpenAI 的端點執行提示詞，但不會記錄結果，因此需要額外選項來儲存標準輸出和標準錯誤（推理追蹤）。以下是我針對 Kimi K3.1 Pro 在其支援的三個推理級別（low、medium 和 max）下獲得的鵜鶘圖像。這是 max：作為對比，我針對 Kimi K3 在這三個級別上執行了新的鵜鶘圖像
